name: status
description: Poll a background shell (started by the Bash tool's run_in_background mode) by its shell_id. Maps onto NexusShellService.ReadBackgroundOutput. While running, stdout/stderr contain output captured so far. Returns { found, running, stdout, stderr, stdoutTruncated, stderrTruncated, exitCode?, signal?, timedOut?, killed?, durationMs? }.

inputs.name: shellId
inputs.description: The opaque shell_id returned by a Bash run_in_background launch.
